submitted.rationale: All three measured compositions gave cathodic (negative) photocurrent, which fits p-type CuBi2O4/CuO behavior. The merit is signed and the goal is a photoanode, so the highest value is the least negative one. Bi-rich index 7 (Bi 0.83) gave -4.4e-7 A, better than the CuBi2O4 stoichiometry at index 6 (-9.9e-7 A) and Bi≈Cu at index 13 (-9.3e-7 A). The trend points toward the Bi2O3-rich end of the line.

rejected.reason: The CuBi2O4 stoichiometry gave a strongly cathodic photocurrent (-9.9e-7 A), as expected for a p-type photocathode.
Bi≈Cu gave a cathodic photocurrent (-9.3e-7 A).
Not measured. A CuO-dominated film is expected to be p-type and cathodic, so it should score worse on a signed anodic merit.
